overview: A menu of particles to throw off yourself. Press V, pick one, and everybody nearby sees it.
For saying yes across a build site without stopping to type.

1.0.2: A mod menu icon showing four of the emotes, rather than loose confetti.
1.0.1: Twelve emotes on one key: love, yes, no, music, party, magic, spark, boom, fire, smoke, snow, poof.
Every button wears the particle it throws.
A burst lasts a second and follows you as you walk.
/emote love skips the menu for a command block or a macro.
